commander.name: Delina, Wild Mage
commander.oracle_text:
Whenever Delina attacks, choose target creature you control, then roll a d20.
1—14 | Create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary and it has "At end of combat, exile this token."
15—20 | Create one of those tokens. You may roll again.

themes.name: Encore of the Wild Mage
themes.pitch: Every attack copies your best enters-the-battlefield creature, so each combat replays its value again and again.

themes.name: Ambush of Echoes
themes.pitch: Send a wide, aggressive board into combat while Delina's copies pour in tapped and attacking.

themes.name: Wild Mage Coven
themes.pitch: Fill the table with Shamans, Goblins and Elves, then copy whichever one is doing the most work.

themes.name: Critical Hit Cavalry
themes.pitch: Copies are exiled at end of combat, so make each one connect first and cash in on the damage.

themes.name: Natural Twenty Titans
themes.pitch: Copy a giant trampling fatty and watch a double-sized swing crush the table.

themes.name: Wild Magic Surge
themes.pitch: Chaos is the plan: cast whatever you exile, steal what you can, and copy what you can't.
